label: C3-launcher-range-write-removed
why: Removes the write-mode range recording from the launcher. The write run then exits 0 having committed real work with no row saying CODEX wrote it, those commits fall into loop.py's complement, and the independence gate goes on to demand a CODEX review of CODEX's own code — a fail-open that wears the costume of a passing run. This is the mutant the addendum's gap-2 mitigation names: a missing row must be a RED run, so the test that asserts the row exists after a successful write block is the one that has to kill it.
old:
if ! python3 "$HERE/loop.py" range record --arc "$CC_LOOP_ARC" --track "$CC_LOOP_TRACK" \
               --task "$CC_LOOP_NAME" --party codex \
               --start-sha "$START_SHA" --end-sha "$END_SHA" >&2; then
